description: Return one generated project file. The path must exactly match a value returned by listProjectFiles. Text is returned as UTF-8 and binary content as Base64. Successful calls record MCP usage and activity for this project. Generated files can include private signing keys for RSA JWT configurations; treat them as sensitive.

path.description: An exact generated path returned by listProjectFiles

projectId.description: The project ID returned by startProject

name: getProjectFile

userProjectChanged.description: Present only once when the project appears to have been changed by the user since the preceding MCP call within the last two hours

title: Read a generated project file
